name: North Carolina

notes: Food is exempt from the state tax and taxed at a 2% local rate.
Motor fuel is exempt from the general sales tax (per-gallon excise instead).
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.
gaps: North Carolina has no city sales taxes; each county's rate (2% or 2.25% local) plus the 0.5% transit taxes (Durham, Mecklenburg, Orange and Wake) and the 1% Mecklenburg tax that started July 1, 2026 apply to the whole county.
Prepared food and beverage taxes some counties and cities levy (for example in Mecklenburg, Wake and Durham) are not included.
Food for home consumption is taxed at 2% local only; that reduced rate is a taxability question, not part of the general rate here.
